description: External resources to monitor for changes. The scheduled agent will fetch each source, compute a content hash, and trigger updates when changes are detected.

sources.name: Bank of Thailand - Financial Institutions Policy (AML/CFT Supervision)
sources.relevance: Core BOT policy page governing AML/CFT supervision framework for Thai commercial banks. Changes here indicate new circulars or regulatory direction.

sources.name: FATF Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring (Grey List)
sources.relevance: FATF grey/black list changes affect EDD triggers and risk scoring logic. Country list updates require risk model recalibration.

sources.name: BOT Notifications and Circulars (Financial Institutions)
sources.relevance: Official BOT notifications and circulars for commercial banks. New entries may contain AML/CFT compliance requirements, KYC updates, or CDD guideline changes.

sources.name: BOT News - AML/CFT Joint Advisories
sources.relevance: BOT news page where joint BOT/AMLO press releases and advisories are published (e.g., June 2024 Myanmar EDD advisory). New advisories require immediate compliance response.
